# Definition
For a set $V = \{e, a, b, c \}$, ***Klein 4-group*** is a group $\langle V, \ast \rangle$ with the following group table:

$$\begin{array}{c|cccc}
* & e & a & b & c \\
\hline
e & e & a & b & c \\
a & a & e & c & b \\
b & b & c & e & a \\
c & c & b & a & e \\
\end{array}$$

## Properties
**(i)** $V \cong \mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2$

# Reference
- John B. Fraleigh. (2004). A First Course in Abstract Algebra (7th ed.). Pearson.
